mainEntity.name: What permits are typically required for a room expansion in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for a room expansion in cities like Berkeley, Oakland, or Albany generally depend on the scope of work. Projects involving structural changes, such as removing load-bearing walls, or significant alterations to plumbing or electrical systems will require building permits. Non-structural cosmetic changes might not, but it's always best to check with your local planning department. We assist clients in navigating these local permitting processes to ensure compliance.
